Hi Alex,

Great to connect earlier — thanks for the thoughtful discussion about Acme's search and summarization use cases. Quick recap from my side:

- Primary goal: reduce average search latency and improve relevance for customer-facing knowledge base.
- Success metrics you mentioned: 15%+ improvement in relevant-click rate, sub-300ms median inference latency for single-query paths, and predictable per-token cost for peak traffic.
- Data: you'll start with product KB + curated support articles (no PII), ~250k documents.

Next step: schedule an evaluation kickoff where we can:
1) Align success criteria and trial plan (pilot dataset, evaluation prompt set, timelines)
2) Walk through a technical deep dive (architecture, network/access, model variants, quantization options)
3) Kick off access for a sandbox eval environment and share the prompt set/evals.

I have availability next week: Wed, Dec 2 (10-12 PT) or Mon, Dec 7 (10-12 PT). Would either work for your team? Who should join from Acme (tech lead, security, product)?

I've attached a short kickoff agenda and a template eval plan to make it easier to capture success metrics. If you prefer, I can send a calendar invite once we confirm a time.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this started.

Best,
Marissa
